content: Still stuck. Facing changes but no movement. This is a real blocker. Let me save a lesson and search the wiki for "cannot move" / stuck.

args.lesson: When standing on the notice board tile at Workshop (2,7) and direction keys only change facing but never move, do not keep retrying movement; instead try interacting (KeyE) with the notice board or look for another way off the tile, because the board's collision traps the body.
